```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. SUBSET HI
# =====================================================

physeq_HI <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  study_group == "HI"
)

physeq_HI <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HI) > 0,
  physeq_HI
)

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_HI)

physeq_HI <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_HI,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_HI <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HI) > 5,
  physeq_HI
)

physeq_HI

# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_HI <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HI))

meta_HI <- meta_HI %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    logCD4 = log10(CD4.Count.1)
  )

meta_HI$logCD4_c <- scale(
  meta_HI$logCD4,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)

# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

cytok_LLOD30 <- masaliva_LODimputed389_filt  # substitute maplasma_LODimputed389_filt when using plasma

colnames(cytok_LLOD30)

cyto_HI <- cytok_LLOD30[
  rownames(meta_HI),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_HI_log <- log10(cyto_HI + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. Adjust CYTOKINES
# for age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_HI <- apply(
  cyto_HI_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_HI
    )
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_HI <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_HI)
rownames(cyto_resid_HI) <- rownames(meta_HI)

```


# mclust HI Saliva
```{r}

# Choose cytokine matrix
cytok_mat <- cyto_resid_HI

# Keep shared samples only
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(cytok_mat), rownames(meta_HI))

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub_HI <- meta_HI[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance variables
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(cytok_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[, vars > 0, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# Scale data
# -----------------------------
X <- scale(cytok_mat)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(
  X,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Scree plot
fviz_eig(
  pca_res,
  addlabels = TRUE,
  ylim = c(0, 60)
) +
  ggtitle("HI Cytokines: Scree Plot")

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================

n_pcs <- which(cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.80)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)

summary(mc)

# Cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)

# Add to metadata
meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster <- clusters

table(meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster)

```



# Biplot HI saliva

```{r}

#----------------------------------------------------------
# BIPLOT
#---------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================
# PCA dataframe
# =========================================================

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca_res$x),
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_res$x[, 3],
  meta_sub_HI
)

# -----------------------------
# PCA scores (samples)
# -----------------------------
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
scores$Cluster <- pca_df$Mclust_cluster

# -----------------------------
# PCA loadings (variables)
# -----------------------------
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation)

# scale arrows for visualization
arrow_scale <- 3

loadings$Cytokine <- rownames(loadings)

# variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(100 * var_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(100 * var_explained[2], 1)

cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#D73027",
  "2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "3" = "#1B9E77"
)

p_HI <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      yend = PC2 * arrow_scale
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      y = PC2 * arrow_scale,
      label = Cytokine
    ),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "S1",
      "2" = "S2",
      "3" = "S3"
    ),
    name = "HI Phenotype"
  )  +
  labs(
    #title = "PCA Biplot of Saliva Cytokine Clusters in HI",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_HI

```


# Box plot HI saliva
```{r}
plot_df <- cytok_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = clusters,
    Sample = rownames(cytok_mat)
  )


# -----------------------------
# Convert to long format
# -----------------------------
plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cluster, Sample),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  )


# =========================================================
# Create saliva phenotype labels
# 1 = S1, 2 = S2, 3 = S3
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
  labels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# 1. GLOBAL TEST (Kruskal-Wallis for 3 groups)
# =========================================================

kw_df <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  kruskal_test(Value ~ Phenotype) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Y POSITION FOR GLOBAL STARS
# =========================================================

y_pos <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(
    y.position = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10
  )

kw_df <- kw_df %>%
  left_join(y_pos, by = "Cytokine")


# =========================================================
# Fixed phenotype order
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Phenotype,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# Cytokine order
# =========================================================

plot_long_order <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    Cytokine = factor(
      Cytokine,
      levels = c(
        # Inflammatory / innate
        "Saliva_IL1_alpha",
        "Saliva_IL8",
        "Saliva_MCP1",

        # Adaptive / Th1-Th2
        "Saliva_IFN_gamma",
        "Saliva_IL4",
        "Saliva_IL5"
        #"Saliva_IL6" # not significant, commented out to make even figure panel
      )
    )
  )


table(plot_long_order$Cytokine)


# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Phenotype,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Phenotype")


# =========================================================
# Phenotype colors
# =========================================================

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "S1" = "#D73027",
  "S2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "S3" = "#1B9E77"
)


# =========================================================
# PLOTS
# =========================================================

cytokine_order <- levels(plot_long_order$Cytokine)

p_list <- lapply(cytokine_order, function(cyt) {

  subdf <- plot_long_order %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  pair_sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)


  ggplot(
    subdf,
    aes(
      x = Phenotype,
      y = Value,
      fill = Phenotype
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Phenotype),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pair_sub,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    labs(
      title = gsub("Saliva_", "", cyt),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})


# =========================================================
# COMBINE PLOTS
# =========================================================

# global_title <- "Saliva Cytokine Levels Across Phenotypes in HI"

final_plot_HI_saliva <- wrap_plots(
  p_list,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_annotation(
    # title = global_title
  )

final_plot_HI_saliva

```

# significance and Effect size table

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# =========================================================
# Rank-biserial effect sizes for each pairwise comparison
# =========================================================

eff12 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "2")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "2"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff13 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff23 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("2", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "2",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

effect_df <- bind_rows(
  eff12,
  eff13,
  eff23
) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  )

# =========================================================
# Merge Wilcoxon results with effect sizes
# =========================================================

wilcox_effect_table <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(
    effect_df,
    by = c("Cytokine", "group1", "group2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 1),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p.adj = signif(p.adj, 3),
    effsize = round(effsize, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    n1,
    n2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p.adj,
    p.adj.signif,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2
  )

# =========================================================
# Display
# =========================================================

print(wilcox_effect_table)

# Optional data frame for export
wilcox_effect_table_df <- as.data.frame(wilcox_effect_table)

wilcox_effect_table_df


# Median table final use!
## Median for direction


median_table_wide <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_low = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_high = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median = round(median, 3),
    IQR_low = round(IQR_low, 3),
    IQR_high = round(IQR_high, 3),
    Value = paste0(median, " (", IQR_low, "–", IQR_high, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(Cytokine, Cluster, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = Value,
    names_prefix = "Phenotype "
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cytokine)

median_table_wide


```



#Beta diversity

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Create phyloseq object with HI cluster assignments
# =========================================================

if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HI)) {
  physeq_HI <- t(physeq_HI)
}

physeq_HI

physeq_HI_clust <- physeq_HI

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HI$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HI$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HI$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HI$host_sex)
meta_sub_HI$VL_bin <- factor(meta_sub_HI$VL_bin)
rownames(meta_sub_HI) <- meta_sub_HI$host_subject_id



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HI_clust) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HI)

physeq_HI_clust

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract OTU table (counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_HI_clust), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_HI_clust)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- data.frame(otu)

dim(otu)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HI_clust))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- otu / rowSums(otu)

bray <- vegdist(
  otu,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pcoa <- cmdscale(
  bray,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

var_exp <- pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0])

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
  meta
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Overall PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)


perm_cluster <- adonis2(
  bray ~Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c +
    #viral_load_binary +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary,
  data = meta,
  by = "margin"
)

perm_cluster

# =========================================================
# Pairwise PERMANOVA
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 2
# -------------------------
phy_12 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HI_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "2")
)

phy_12 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_12) > 0,
  phy_12
)

bray_12 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_12,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_12 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_12))

set.seed(123)
adonis_12 <- adonis2(
  bray_12 ~Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary,
  data = meta_12,
  by = "margin"
)

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 3
# -------------------------
phy_13 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HI_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "3")
)

phy_13 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_13) > 0,
  phy_13
)

bray_13 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_13,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_13 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_13))

set.seed(123)

adonis_13 <- adonis2(
  bray_13 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary,
  data = meta_13,
  by = "margin"
)

# -------------------------
# 2 vs 3
# -------------------------
phy_23 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HI_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("2", "3")
)

phy_23 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_23) > 0,
  phy_23
)

bray_23 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_23,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_23 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_23))

set.seed(123)

adonis_23 <- adonis2(
  bray_23 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary,
  data = meta_23,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_12
adonis_13
adonis_23
```

# Plot Beta diversity saliva HI 
```{r}

# =====================================================
# 1. Bray-Curtis PCoA
# =====================================================

# Relative abundance
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  physeq_HI_clust,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)

# Bray distance
bray <- phyloseq::distance(
  ps_rel,
  method = "bray"
)

# PCoA
ord <- ordinate(
  ps_rel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray
)

# Extract coordinates
coords <- as.data.frame(ord$vectors[, 1:2])

# Add sample metadata
plot_df <- cbind(
  coords,
  as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel))
)

# Rename axes with % variance
axis1 <- round(100 * ord$values$Relative_eig[1], 1)
axis2 <- round(100 * ord$values$Relative_eig[2], 1)


# =====================================================
# 2. Pairwise PERMANOVA p-values
# =====================================================

pairwise_p <- data.frame(
  group1 = c("S1", "S1", "S2"),
  group2 = c("S2", "S3", "S3"),
  p = c(
    0.022,
    0.020,
    0.589
  )
)

pairwise_p$label <- paste0(
  pairwise_p$group1,
  " vs ",
  pairwise_p$group2,
  ": p=",
  formatC(
    pairwise_p$p,
    format = "f",
    digits = 3
  )
)


# =====================================================
# Calculate centroids
# =====================================================

centroids <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Mclust_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Axis.1 = mean(Axis.1),
    Axis.2 = mean(Axis.2)
  )

# Merge centroid coordinates back to samples
plot_df_spider <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(
    centroids,
    by = "Mclust_cluster",
    suffix = c("", "_centroid")
  )


# =====================================================
# Calculate centroids and spider lines
# =====================================================

centroids <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Mclust_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    centroid_x = mean(Axis.1),
    centroid_y = mean(Axis.2)
  )


plot_df_spider <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(
    centroids,
    by = "Mclust_cluster"
  )


# =====================================================
# Plot with spider lines + centroids
# =====================================================

dmm_cols <- c(
  "1" = "#D73027",
  "2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "3" = "#1B9E77"
)


p <- ggplot(
  plot_df_spider,
  aes(
    Axis.1,
    Axis.2,
    color = Mclust_cluster
  )
) +

  # spider lines to centroid
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      xend = centroid_x,
      yend = centroid_y
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # samples
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # centroids
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = centroid_x,
      y = centroid_y,
      fill = Mclust_cluster
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 6,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +

  # centroid labels
  geom_text(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = centroid_x,
      y = centroid_y,
      label = paste0("S", Mclust_cluster)
    ),
    color = "black",
    vjust = -1.2,
    size = 4
  ) +

  stat_ellipse(
```

# PLASMA

# Plasma HI

```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. SUBSET HI
# =====================================================

physeq_HI <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  study_group == "HI"
)

physeq_HI <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HI) > 0,
  physeq_HI
)

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_HI)

physeq_HI <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_HI,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_HI <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HI) > 5,
  physeq_HI
)

physeq_HI

# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_HI <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HI))

meta_HI <- meta_HI %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    logCD4 = log10(CD4.Count.1)
  )

meta_HI$logCD4_c <- scale(
  meta_HI$logCD4,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)

# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

cytok_LLOD30 <- maplasma_LODimputed389_filt  # substitute maplasma_LODimputed389_filt when using plasma

colnames(cytok_LLOD30)

cyto_HI <- cytok_LLOD30[
  rownames(meta_HI),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_HI_log <- log10(cyto_HI + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. ADJUST CYTOKINES
# for age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_HI <- apply(
  cyto_HI_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_HI
    )
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_HI <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_HI)
rownames(cyto_resid_HI) <- rownames(meta_HI)

```


# mclust HI plasma
```{r}

# Choose cytokine matrix
cytok_mat <- cyto_resid_HI

# Keep shared samples only
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(cytok_mat), rownames(meta_HI))

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub_HI <- meta_HI[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance variables
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(cytok_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[, vars > 0, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# Scale data
# -----------------------------
X <- scale(cytok_mat)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(
  X,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Scree plot
fviz_eig(
  pca_res,
  addlabels = TRUE,
  ylim = c(0, 60)
) +
  ggtitle("HI Cytokines: Scree Plot")

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================

n_pcs <- which(cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.80)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)

summary(mc)

# Cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)

# Add to metadata
meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster <- clusters

table(meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster)

```

```{r}

#----------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================

pca_df <- data.frame(

)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)

# PCA loadings (variables)

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation)

loadings$Cytokine <- rownames(loadings)

# variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(100 * var_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(100 * var_explained[2], 1)

    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare dataframe

plot_df <- cytok_mat %>%

  )


# =========================================================
# Convert to long format

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cluster, Sample),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  )


# =========================================================
# Create plasma phenotype labels
# 1 = P1, 2 = P2
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2"),
  labels = c("P1", "P2")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Phenotype,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Phenotype")


# =========================================================
# Plasma phenotype colors
# =========================================================

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "P1" = "#D73027",
  "P2" = "#2C7BB6"
)


# =========================================================
# Plot each cytokine
# =========================================================

cytokine_order <- unique(plot_long$Cytokine)

p_list <- lapply(cytokine_order, function(cyt) {

  subdf <- plot_long %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  pair_sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  ggplot(
    subdf,
    aes(
      x = Phenotype,
      y = Value,
      fill = Phenotype
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Phenotype),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pair_sub,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = phenotype_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = phenotype_colors) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    labs(
      title = gsub("Plasma_", "", cyt),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})


# =========================================================
# Combine plots

) +
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Create phyloseq object with HI plasma cluster assignments
# =========================================================

if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HI)) {
  physeq_HI <- t(physeq_HI)
}

physeq_HI

physeq_HI_clust <- physeq_HI

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HI$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HI$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HI$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HI$host_sex)
meta_sub_HI$VL_bin <- factor(meta_sub_HI$VL_bin)
rownames(meta_sub_HI) <- meta_sub_HI$host_subject_id


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HI_clust) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HI)

physeq_HI_clust

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract OTU table (counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_HI_clust), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_HI_clust)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HI_clust))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- otu / rowSums(otu)

bray <- vegdist(
  otu,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pcoa <- cmdscale(
  bray,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

var_exp <- pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0])

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
  meta
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Overall PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

perm_cluster <- adonis2(
  bray ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c +
    #viral_load_binary +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary,
  data = meta,
  by = "margin"
)

perm_cluster
```

```{r}
ancom_res_HI_plasma <- ancombc2( 
  data = physeq_HI_ancom,
  
  fix_formula = "Mclust_cluster + caries_IL  +  host_age + host_sex + VL_bin + therapy_binary + logCD4_c",  
  
  # No random effects
  rand_formula = NULL,
  
  tax_level = "Species",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  
  group = "Mclust_cluster", #caries_IL
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  
  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100,
    verbose = TRUE
  ),
  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100
  ),
  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
  
  mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "BH", B = 1),
  
  global = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  dunnet = TRUE,
  trend = FALSE,
  
  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cl = 2
)


mclust2 <- ancom_res_HI_plasma$res %>% dplyr::select(taxon, lfc_Mclust_cluster2, 
                                           q_Mclust_cluster2,passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2) %>% filter(                                            passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2 == TRUE) 


caries <- ancom_res_HI_plasma$res %>% dplyr::select(taxon, 
                                lfc_caries_IL1, q_caries_IL1, passed_ss_caries_IL1) %>%                                         filter(q_caries_IL1 < 0.1 , passed_ss_caries_IL1 == TRUE) %>% arrange (lfc_caries_IL1)



mclust2_use <- mclust2%>% select( taxon, lfc_Mclust_cluster2,q_Mclust_cluster2 ,
                                  passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2 ) %>%filter(q_Mclust_cluster2 < 0.1,                                        passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2 == TRUE ) %>% arrange(lfc_Mclust_cluster2)
```

```{r}

# Volcano 1 
#2 vs 1


#####
##### Volcano plot: all points shown, only significant taxa labeled

df_volcano <- mclust2

# ---- Prepare data ----
df_volcano <- df_volcano %>%
  mutate(
    color_group = case_when(
      lfc_Mclust_cluster2 < 0 ~ "P1",
      TRUE ~ "P2"
    ),
    
    # Clean taxon names
    feature = taxon %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bsp\\.\\b", "sp.") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+(ATCC|DSM|str\\.|F|CS)\\s*\\d+") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+unknown$") %>%
      str_replace("^([A-Z][a-z]+) unknown$", "\\1 sp.") %>%
      str_replace("sp\\. oral taxon (\\d+).*", "sp. oral taxon \\1") %>%
      str_squish(),
    
    # Italic labels for plotting
    feature_label = paste0("italic('", feature, "')")
  )

# ---- Volcano plot ----
cf_volcano_HI_plasma <- ggplot(
  df_volcano,
  aes(
    x = lfc_Mclust_cluster2,
    y = -log10(q_Mclust_cluster2),
    color = color_group
  )
) +
  
  # Plot all taxa
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 4) +
  
  # Label only taxa meeting criteria
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_volcano %>%
      filter(
        q_Mclust_cluster2 < 0.1,
        passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2 == TRUE
      ),
    aes(label = feature_label),
    parse = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "P1" =  "#D73027", #"#2C7BB6",
      "P2" =  "#2C7BB6" # "#FDAE61"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Reference lines
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Effect Size (Coefficient)",
    y = expression(-log[10](q-value)),
    color = "HI Phenotype" #,
    #title = "Differentially abundant taxa associated with saliva cytokine clusters2 in HI"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ---- Plot ----
cf_volcano_HI_plasma
```

# Saliva and plasma concordance heatmap

```{r}

# contingency table
table(meta_HI_saliva_mclust$Mclust_cluster , meta_HI_plasma_mclust$Mclust_cluster)

cont_df <- meta_HI_saliva_mclust %>%
  select(host_subject_id, Saliva = Mclust_cluster) %>%
  inner_join(
    meta_HI_plasma_mclust %>%
      select(host_subject_id, Plasma = Mclust_cluster),
    by = "host_subject_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Saliva, Plasma) %>%
  group_by(Saliva) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)

cont_df

# heatmap
sal_vs_plas_concord_HI <- ggplot(cont_df,
       aes(x = factor(Plasma),
           y = factor(Saliva),
           fill = percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", round(percent,1), "%)")),
            size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#B2182B"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    #title = "Saliva vs Plasma Immune Phenotype Concordance in HI",
    x = "HI Plasma immune phenotype",
    y = "HI Saliva immune phenotype",
    fill = "% within saliva phenotype"
  ) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

sal_vs_plas_concord_HI
```

```{r}
# ================================
# Continuous variables
# ================================

# Age
age_test_HI <- kruskal_test(
  meta_sub_HI,
  host_age ~ Mclust_cluster
)

age_test_HI


# ================================
# Categorical variables (descriptive)
# ================================

# Sex
sex_table_HI <- table(
  meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HI$host_sex
)

sex_test_HI <- fisher.test(sex_table_HI)
sex_test_HI

# Caries
caries_table_HI <- table(
  meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HI$caries_IL
)

caries_test_HI <- fisher.test(caries_table_HI)
caries_test_HI


# Viral load category
VL_bin_HI <- table(
  meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HI$VL_bin
)

VL_bin_HI <- fisher.test(VL_bin_HI)
VL_bin_HI

# Therapy status
therapy_table_HI <- table(
  meta_sub_HI$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HI$therapy_binary
)

therapy_test_HI <- fisher.test(therapy_table_HI)

# Display unadjusted tests
age_test_HI
sex_test_HI
caries_test_HI
viral_test_HI
therapy_test_HI


#Adjusted tests
# =========================================================
# Relevel cluster (Cluster 3 as reference)
# =========================================================

meta_sub_HI_ <- meta_sub_HI

meta_sub_HI_$Mclust_cluster <- factor(
  meta_sub_HI_$Mclust_cluster,
  levels = c("3", "1", "2")
)
# =========================================================
# Fit linear regression
# =========================================================

fit_cd4_adj <- lm(
  logCD4 ~ Mclust_cluster + host_age + host_sex + caries_IL + VL_bin,
  data = meta_sub_HI_
)

summary(fit_cd4_adj)

# Estimated differences with 95% CI
cd4_effects <- cbind(
  Estimate = coef(fit_cd4_adj),
  confint(fit_cd4_adj)
)

cd4_effects

# =========================================================
# Logistic regression models
# =========================================================

# -------------------------------
# Caries
# -------------------------------
set.seed(123)
fit_caries_HI <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ Mclust_cluster +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    VL_bin +
    therapy_binary +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_sub_HI_,
  family = binomial
)

summary(fit_caries_HI)

exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(fit_caries_HI),
  confint(fit_caries_HI)
))
```

# concordance metric, Adjusted Rand Index

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Match subjects with saliva and plasma clusters (HI)
# =========================================================

cluster_compare_HI <- meta_HI_saliva_mclust %>%
  select(
    host_subject_id,
    Saliva_cluster = Mclust_cluster
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    meta_HI_plasma_mclust %>%
      select(
        host_subject_id,
        Plasma_cluster = Mclust_cluster
      ),
    by = "host_subject_id"
  )


# =========================================================
# Contingency table
# =========================================================

cluster_table_HI <- table(
  cluster_compare_HI$Saliva_cluster,
  cluster_compare_HI$Plasma_cluster
)

cluster_table_HI


# =========================================================
# Adjusted Rand Index (primary concordance measure)
# =========================================================

ARI_HI <- adjustedRandIndex(
  cluster_compare_HI$Saliva_cluster,
  cluster_compare_HI$Plasma_cluster
)

ARI_HI




```
